title: Occupational Disruption and Role Strain During Perimenopause
official: Occupational Disruption and Role Strain During Perimenopause: A Mixed-Methods Study
summary: The purpose of this sequential exploratory mixed-methods study is to examine the relationship between perimenopausal symptom severity and occupational performance, occupational balance, and role participation in women aged 40-55. A secondary purpose is to explore the lived experience of occupational disruption during perimenopause through qualitative interviews.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women aged 40-55
* Self-reported perimenopausal symptoms
* Currently employed (paid or unpaid) or managing household roles
* English-speaking

Exclusion Criteria:

* Surgical menopause
* Current pregnancy
